policy: Experimental player/minute associations, not causal injury values or calibrated betting adjustments. Recent five-game rotation is the reference; existing absences are not charged twice. Uncertain statuses get play/out scenarios, not assigned probabilities. Replacement minutes are redistributed among recent participants up to 48 each; announced starters/minute limits are not verified. Missing reports never mean healthy. A separate experimental injury-adjusted spread/total projection applies listed-out replacement changes when supported. Baseline probabilities, leans, locked cards and stakes stay unchanged.
